_about: Answer key for `culprit bench`. Culprit repo only: never copy any of it into the victim repo, an LLM prompt or Entire text. Keys match `name` in scenarios.yaml. `hunks` line ranges are in the file at the culprit commit (`lines`), or at its parent for removed code (`parent_lines`), as `git show <sha>` reports them. `visible` records, per victim model, whether a separate measurement showed the bug is detectable (true / false); a missing model means not measured. It must come from a strength check with its own runs (bench/strength.md, with run IDs), never from a Culprit run's own baselines, which would let Culprit grade itself. hist/b's flags come from the separate hero check (6 harder tasks x 3 seeds: 18/18 at good-v1.0, 0/18 at 397c427, on both models; see hackathon.md). Resolved from the RefundDesk clone on 2026-10-10.
